title: Certified lemma (certified-lemma-gated fanout, steps 1-2)
description: A lemma-certification row that gates whether a solved sarf/nahw fact may fan out across Qamus occurrences. Fanout is a lattice projection from certified source facts, NEVER a surface-string replacement. A row may authorize fanout only when certification_status=certified AND the fanout_gate is one of the three orthogonal gate types; surface-only fanout is impossible by construction (there is no surface-only gate value). Particles are function/context-sensitive and may fan out only via source_address_exact or function_context, never lemma_pattern_pos alone. Public fields (lemma_ar, root, pos, pattern, fanout_gate) MUST be source-clean; QAC/MCP/external evidence lives only in evidence_private and is stripped before publication. lemma_id is content-addressed (lemma:sha256[:16] over lemma_ar+root+pos+pattern) so two distinct-meaning homographs cannot collide on one identity. Dry-run; source-clean; deterministic. See CERTIFIED_LEMMA_GATED_FANOUT_PLAN (fablehardening) + its second-pass addendum.

lemma_id.description: Content-addressed: 'lemma:' + first 16 hex of sha256(canonical(lemma_ar,root,pos,pattern)). The validator recomputes and FAILs on mismatch.

root.description: Authored triliteral/quadriliteral root, or null when not determinable. Never paraphrase-laundered from an external lexicon.

source_scope.description: Where the certifying evidence came from. private_qac_cache / mcp_evidence are INTERNAL only; they may support certification but never leak into a public field.

public_safe.description: True only when every public field is authored Qamus output with no external label.

evidence_private.description: Internal-only evidence breadcrumbs (may name qac/mcp). Stripped before any public artifact. Never echoed into a public field.

fanout_allowed.description: Impossible to be true unless certification_status=certified. Enforced by the validator, not just the schema.

fanout_gate.description: Orthogonal gate type. There is deliberately NO surface-only value: 'surface-only is never a gate' is enforced as a validator rule, and any legacy never_surface_only value FAILs the enum.

evidence_scope.description: Does the certifying evidence cover the WHOLE token or only a component (prefix/suffix/stem)? fanout_allowed with evidence_scope=component is rejected — component-only evidence cannot certify a whole token. Absent = whole_token assumed (back-compat).

reason_agreement.description: Do the sarf (morphology) and nahw (syntax) reasons AGREE for this certification? fanout_allowed with reason_agreement=disagree is rejected (block, don't fan out). Absent = not asserted (back-compat); a certified row SHOULD carry agree.

review_votes.description: Count of independent review votes behind this certification. lemma_pattern_pos fanout requires >=2 (two-vote); function_context requires >=2 OR source_scope in {owner_review,scholar_review}. source_address_exact needs none (mechanical + owner).
